 Print RRB Group D result 2026 expected to be released soon The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) are expected to announce the RRB Group D result 2026 soon. Candidates who appeared for the Level 1 Computer-Based Test (CBT) will be able to check their qualifying status on the official website, indianrailways.gov.in, as well as the respective regional RRB websites. The board will release the result in PDF format. Candidates will be able to check whether they have qualified for the next stage by searching for their roll numbers in the result list. The RRBs will also publish zone-wise cut-off marks and individual scorecards. The RRB Group D examination was conducted from August 3 to August 25 for recruitment to 22,195 Level 1 posts across different railway zones. The answer key and candidate response sheets were released on September 7. Candidates were allowed to raise objections against the provisional answer key until September 17. How to check RRB Group D Result 2026?
 Once the results are announced, candidates can follow these steps to check and download their results: Visit the official website of the respective regional Railway Recruitment Board.
 Open the latest notifications or results section.
 Click on the link for RRB Group D Result 2026 under CEN 09/2025.
 The result PDF containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates will appear on the screen.
 Use the Ctrl+F option to search for your roll number.
 Download the result PDF and save it for future reference.
 Candidates will also be able to access their individual scorecards through the login link. They will need to enter their registration number and password or other login details specified by the board. RRB Group D selection process 2026
 Candidates who qualify in the CBT will be shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Those who clear the PET will have to appear for document verification, followed by a medical examination. The recruitment drive aims to fill 22,195 Level 1 vacancies across different railway zones. The posts include Track Maintainer Grade IV, Pointsman B and various assistant positions. The RRBs will publish further updates regarding the next stages of the recruitment process, including examination schedules and instructions, on their respective regional websites. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official RRB websites for the latest updates on the result and further selection process.
